policy.typed_values: Each typed value names its source file and an anchor_text that must occur in that file after whitespace normalization; the producer and the verifier both check the anchor.
policy.parent_receipts: Values marked as read from a parent receipt are read at build time; the receipt bytes must match the pinned sha256.
policy.displays: Entries of kind display are paper-rendered roundings used only as cross-checks against the mechanically read values.

P_C.note: typed to the sixteen decimals of the ledger brief; the paper prints further digits

euler_number.note: the clock-branch coefficient named in the edge-center theorem as a separate diagnostic hypothesis
